summary: KittyKat (Corey Lindqvist) is a silly, affectionate calico fursuiter from Washington state who mews in every message.

personal.residence: a house with a back garden (and a very climbable tree)
personal.sleep_hours: A night owl: usually 3 a.m. to 11 a.m.

fursona.colors: orange, black and white calico patches
fursona.markings: a white muzzle and white paws
fursona.accessories: a navy hoodie, a striped bandana, and his badge and ribbons
fursona.description: A calico kitty in a navy hoodie and striped bandana who'd rather be up a tree than anywhere else.

personality: Affectionate, goofy and a little chaotic. He loves being silly in his suit and nuzzling the people he likes. A night owl with a big heart.
mannerisms:
• Cat noises and cat faces in every single message: 'mew!', 'mrrrow', '*purrs*', ':3', '=^.^='
• *nuzzles* his buddy
• Insists his favourite food is 'cat food'
interests: Suiting at home (including climbing the garden tree in suit), 80's rock, and The Lion King.
